clips.author: Viceskeeni2
clips.preparation: ffmpeg decode to 24 kHz mono PCM16; leading/trailing silence (amplitude below -46 dBFS) trimmed; whole call kept; gain min(0.13/rms, 0.65/peak) = 0.8851; 20 ms edge fades
clips.description: Field recording made in the streets of Istanbul (uploaded 2025-09-05) capturing the muadhin's amplified call to prayer, adhan, ringing over the city.

clips.author: D.jones
clips.preparation: ffmpeg decode to 24 kHz mono PCM16; highest second-weakest 0.5 s RMS block (ties: louder window), 0.5 s start step; gain min(0.13/rms, 0.65/peak) = 0.6500; 20 ms edge fades
clips.description: '04 Wood Fire, Inside Stove' - close-up recording of a wood fire crackling inside a small stove.

clips.author: milcahrawr
clips.preparation: ffmpeg decode to 24 kHz mono PCM16; highest-RMS 10 s inside a 60 s window centred on the source midpoint (skip the first 60 s), 0.25 s start step; gain min(0.13/rms, 0.65/peak) = 0.7977; 20 ms edge fades
clips.description: 'Muffled Variety Program' - a muffled, low-intelligibility TV/variety-program murmur meant as a background TV-in-the-next-room bed; uploader states it was made from 'King of Jazz' (1930), a public-domain film, so it contains no protected broadcast content.

clips.author: craigsmith
clips.preparation: ffmpeg decode to 24 kHz mono PCM16; highest-energy 7 s around the liveliest group reaction, 0.1 s start step; gain min(0.13/rms, 0.65/peak) = 2.6796; 20 ms edge fades
clips.description: 'R27-22-Medium Group Talk and Cheer' - a medium group of people happily chatting and laughing, occasionally reacting positively together; warm, casual group laughter.

clips.author: Breviceps
clips.preparation: ffmpeg decode to 24 kHz mono PCM16; highest-energy 10 s keeping 2 s clear of both source edges, 0.1 s start step; gain min(0.13/rms, 0.65/peak) = 6.8574; 20 ms edge fades
clips.description: 'Busy Room Ambience / Small crowd / People talking in background' - non-intelligible people talking in a room, recorded with a Zoom H2n; short 15.7 s loopable room murmur.

clips.author: Sadiquecat
clips.preparation: ffmpeg decode to 24 kHz mono PCM16; highest-energy 6 s around the busiest distant barking, 0.1 s start step; gain min(0.13/rms, 0.65/peak) = 2.1306; 20 ms edge fades
clips.description: 'Rural Distant Dog barks' - distant dog barks recorded in a rural area (Bouriège, Aude, France, 2024) with a Zoom H2n; soft, unobtrusive barking suitable as a cosy looping background bed.

clips.author: Walking.With.Microphones
clips.preparation: ffmpeg decode to 24 kHz mono PCM16; 8 s window at 52.0-60.0 s holding the four clearest isolated caws of the single angry bird, every call kept at least 0.75 s clear of the window edges; gain min(0.13/rms, 0.65/peak) = 0.7072; 20 ms edge fades
clips.description: 'Angry Hooded Crow (Hoodie) (Corvus cornix)' - a single hooded crow (Corvus cornix) cawing and grumbling at the recordist, captured on a ZOOM SGH-6; four loud clear caws over a quiet field-recording floor.
